business.text: Cipla operates 48 manufacturing facilities globally and earns revenue from pharmaceutical product sales upon transfer of product control. India represents approximately 50% of total sales, where the company holds the leading position by volume, and respiratory products account for one third of total business. The company also generates revenue from international markets, including $780 million in North American annual sales, alongside its active pharmaceutical ingredient business.

cites.quote: 48 manufacturing facilities

The Company recognizes revenue from sales of pharmaceutical products, when control of the product is transferred. The Company records product sales net of estimated discounts, right to returns, rebates and other price adjustments.

In FY 2026-27, API business will continue to focus on maintaining a strong market position in top 10 APIs and bringing new business on board with new pipeline molecules and enhancing its market presence via organic launches, partnering with innovators and deepening its footprint by increasing outreach to newer untapped markets.
That's obviously one third of our total business.
50% of the business come from India
the business reported quarterly revenue of USD 155 million and an annual revenue of $780 million, supported by demand in our differentiated portfolio and a steady base business.
We're actually number1 by volume.

narrative.text: Both the annual report and earnings calls emphasize strong overall growth and financial performance, citing annual FY26 revenue of INR 28,163 crores and One India business revenue exceeding INR 12,500 crores. They also agree on global scale, highlighted by EMEU operations growing past $400 million. However, earnings calls shift focus towards specific commercial updates and operational issues, such as the rollout of Yurpeak (tirzepatide), North American revenue fluctuations ($233 million in Q2 FY26 down to $167 million in Q3 FY26), and required U.S. FDA remediation for Lanreotide.

cites.quote: So after Mounjaro, in IQVIA, Yurpeak is the second largest brand.
